title: Button
description: A reusable button component that provides consistent styling and behavior across the application.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import the Button component from the shared components library.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Choose the appropriate variant based on the action's importance and meaning.

danger.name: Danger
danger.description: Use for destructive or dangerous actions.

success.name: Success
success.description: Use for successful or positive actions.

warning.name: Warning
warning.description: Use when the user should pay attention before continuing.

link.name: Link
link.description: Use when the action should visually behave like a link.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Applies an outlined style for secondary or less prominent actions.

default.name: false
default.description: Pass the outline prop as a boolean value (true or false). When true, it applies an outlined style for secondary.
